raw_content.result_title: Can tuning music to 432Hz really heal you? Scientists explain the viral trend
raw_content.evidence: Coverage frames 432Hz as a growing social media trend while scientists push back that the small non-randomized studies show effects are more about perception/interpretation of sound than any special frequency.
raw_content.context: Scientific skepticism alongside popular frequency trend
raw_content.raw_excerpt: less about any single special frequency, and more about how we perceive and interpret sound
